correctness.rationale: The proof handles every attack type. For two omitted vertices in one part, two outside defenders are forced and a third outside selected vertex is necessary exactly when at least one omission remains after the move. For attacks in different parts, the candidate defender sets cover all selected vertices and therefore have distinct representatives. The enumerator counts precisely the heavy-part violations; pairwise overlap can occur only at k=4. A definition-level exhaustive checker confirms the criterion and every coefficient on 128 multipartite types and 64,916 subsets through order ten.

value.rationale: The parameter models two simultaneous attacks and is algorithmically hard even on bipartite and split graphs. The three-guard cap gives a sharp structural simplification on a canonical dense graph class, and the coefficient formulas enumerate every feasible set rather than only optimizing cardinality.
